note: NEW zoom 2026-10-22: the big worktable of R_resto_kitchen_01. No on-image back control: the strip Back ('Back to ... cuisine') is the single way back (gate 8); the kitchen's porthole doors and stairs are visible behind as context, not exits.

items.scene: My AUNT (m'AHNT) in a wide straw sun hat waters her terracotta pot of fresh MINT at the end of the worktable.
An apprentice boy PRAYS (pray-pah-rah-SYOHN) with hands together over his six little bowls of chopped vegetables: the PREPARATION is done.
A FLEET (FREET) of little paper boats with paper sails is moored on the worktable, each loaded with golden FRIES.
A roast fish on its platter gets a huge DOSE (SOHS) of glossy brown SAUCE, with a little pot of extra beside it.
A COOL cat in sunglasses sits NEAR (kew-lee-NEHR) the fish on a tall stool, holding up a golden whisk: a CULINARY prize.
